reason: This plugin is primarily an LLM-model routing utility: it creates a virtual provider that merges configured providers/models and forwards each request to the currently selected provider for that model, with settings and UI controls for per-model provider ordering and switching. It also persists routing configuration for both web and headless profiles, so the user-facing goal is model-provider management and request delegation, not development tooling or content generation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH 模型路由插件，在模型选择与会话请求中按每个模型当前配置的供应商进行转发，并提供模型级别的供应商排序与切换设置。
summaries.en: This is a DSH model routing plugin that forwards requests through the currently configured supplier for each model and provides per-model provider ordering and switching controls in the UI settings.

capabilities: Routes model requests to one active provider at request time within DSH
Lets users configure and switch provider priority and active provider per model
Injects a model-router provider into DSH model selection and a settings panel for provider management
Supports shared routing behavior via `settings.yaml` for web and headless/CLI profiles
